'''''Discrete Applied Mathematics''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] covering [[algorithm]]ic and [[applied mathematics|applied]] areas of [[discrete mathematics]]. It is published by [[Elsevier]] and the editor-in-chief is [[Endre Boros]] ([[Rutgers University]]). The journal was split off from another Elsevier journal, ''[[Discrete Mathematics (journal)|Discrete Mathematics]]'', in 1979,<ref>{{cite journal |last=Harary |first=Frank |authorlink=Frank Harary | year=1979 |title=The explosive growth of graph theory |journal=[[Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences]] |volume=328 |issue=1 |pages=5–11 |doi=10.1111/j.1749-6632.1979.tb17762.x |bibcode=1979NYASA.328....5H |mr=557881|url=https://deepblue.lib.umich.edu/bitstream/2027.42/73316/1/j.1749-6632.1979.tb17762.x.pdf |hdl=2027.42/73316 |hdl-access=free }}</ref> with that journal's founder [[Peter Ladislaw Hammer]] as its founding editor-in-chief.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Hammer |first=Peter Ladislaw |author-link=Peter Ladislaw Hammer |year=2007 |title=Peter Ladislaw Hammer |journal=[[Annals of Operations Research]] |doi=10.1007/s10479-007-0165-5 |volume=149 |issue=1 |pages= 1–2}}</ref>
